I want some work on my neck and lower face and maybe a blepharoplasty, but I don’t want to look 25 years younger. I just want to look a little better. Can I achieve that?
8
27
Most relevant﻿
Karen McCoy Williams
 
·
25w
I understand exactly, and I think my defense, etc. improved my self esteem, mental well-being, and only to a small degree made me look younger. I'd been through a lot of trauma, and thought I looked sad...and like my mother lol. It was an excellent decision for me
Reply
Share
TR Shave
 
·
25w
Ask a surgeon. Tell them you want to look your best and not like an overfilled muppet pretending to be 25. I asked for that and look my age but beautifully presented IMHO. The right surgeon will address the whole person from the neck up. If you do bits and pieces here and there it can look mismatched and you may end up over scrutinising the work and wish you'd done it all in one hit. Talk to as many surgeons as you can then decide.
Reply
